Job Description

Field Service Engineer - EIMEA – India – Coimbatore

SUMMARY:

Accuray EIMEA is searching for a Field Service Engineer, home-office based in Coimbatore region (India).

The person in this position has front-line responsibility for installations, remote and on-site diagnostics prior to repair services as well as preventive maintenance visits on Accuray systems, primarily to Accuray customers located regionally but occasionally throughout all EIMEA Region.

The successful candidate must have proven ability to diagnose and resolve problems on highly sophisticated software, electronic and mechanical robotic devices at clinical sites and major hospitals. Applicants must have the ability to work independently and have effective communication skills.

Field Service engineers may also work hours other than a traditional daytime shift and may also work weekend days as part of their normal workdays with limited notice due to the emergent nature of service work. Regular work schedules are determined by a combination of Accuray’s service obligations and customer service needs and are subject to change as needs arise.

REPORTING TO/DEPARTMENT: 

Deputy Service Manager India

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 

PRODUCT SUPPORT 

Provide installation, repair and maintenance support to Accuray systems.

Support is provided to the customer remotely by phone, internet and by on-site visits, as determined by the machine status or customer requirements.

Promoting the highest level of customer satisfaction through the timely response to customer calls, clear and effective communications, professional appearance, and efficient repair/maintenance activities.

Self-management of schedule and work priorities to ensure that urgent customer requirements are addressed timely and customer satisfaction is optimized.

Accurate and clear documentation of work activities are to be completed within the Accuray Customer Management software program, such that these records provide appropriate documentation of the product service history for Device History File records.

Appropriate care of parts inventory and prompt return of replaced parts that are required to be returned to the Accuray stock for processing.

Appropriate management and timely completion of Timesheets and expense reports incurred in the field service of Accuray systems.

Assist in the development of service documentation, in conjunction with the Accuray Customer Service team.

Assist in the training of further Customer Support staff and customer on site personnel with respect to maintenance and service activities, as required.

Assist in identification and development of Field Support tools and test equipment.

Follow Company training as needed. (e.g., basic technical training of 6 weeks at Accuray Headquarters in the US).

Learn and apply all Accuray internal policies and processes.

Follow local regulations (such as radioprotection rules – attends and runs TUV Audits at customer).

PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT 

Provides feedback through the Madison Customer Service group for service-related product improvements that could improve Mean Time to Access (MTTA) and Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), or improvements in mean Time Between Failures (MTBF).

Assist in the development, documentation, and testing of service tools and design updates to the product.

Works effectively with other engineers, scientists, subcontractors, and consultants.

Support project team activities, with attendance at team meetings, representation of Field Service requirements, and provision of documentation as required.

SAFETY 

Observe Accuray Safety Program requirements and work practices.

Help ensure that safety requirements and quality considerations are pro-actively addressed and implemented in the design of the product.

Communicate to the Accuray corporate, or where possible directly address, quality issues raised by customers, in a timely fashion.

Supports the Accuray Quality System and Safety and Health Program by following procedures and mentoring others.

Takes ownership of individual safety to maintain a safe work environment.

The incumbent may be asked to perform other function-related activities in addition to the above-mentioned responsibilities as reasonably required by business needs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum 3 years’ experience in field service, installation, and troubleshooting complex electronic equipment or bachelor’s degree in with less field experience considered. A basic understanding of medical physics is desirable.

Previous experience in large medical device field service strongly preferred.

Be a self-starter and work without close supervision, be able to successfully schedule, organize and conduct field service activities in assigned territory

Hands-on experience with electronic test equipment.

Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Good H/W and S/W computer skills, including network knowledge. Ability to quickly learn to use new software tools.

Excellent customer relations skills and strong service orientation.

Team player - ability to work well in a close team environment.

Fluent reading, writing and speaking in local language and English.

Must be comfortable with extensive travel (up to 50% travel time), sometimes on short notice, and occasional after-hours support requirements.

To qualify for this position, candidates must be able to furnish proof that they are authorized to work in the country they are applying on a permanent basis without sponsorship.

The Field Service Engineer (FSE) provides highly visible customer support through the performance of on-site installation, as well as overseeing any necessary diagnoses, troubleshooting, service, and repair of complex equipment and systems. Checks out and approves operational quality of system equipment. This role instructs customers in the operation and maintenance of the system and serves as company liaison with customer on administrative and technical matters for assigned projects. The FSE will interpret customers’ needs and clarifies if the responsibility for problem resolution falls to sales personnel, customer support reps, or engineers. This job may include any aspect of field support, and is not limited to system hardware and software, PCs, and networking/wireless networking. 

Location: This position will be Remote out of the Sacramento, CA surrounding area.

 

 

PRODUCT SUPPORT

 

· Provide installation, repair, upgrade, and maintenance support for TomoTherapy and CyberKnife systems located at assigned customer sites

· Promoting customer satisfaction through the timely response to customer calls, clear and effective communications with internal and external customers, professional appearance, and efficient repair/maintenance activities

· Maintain regular communication with direct manager, peer field personnel, and commercial team members for any customer matters requiring attention

· Self-management of schedule and work priorities to ensure that urgent customer requirements are addressed appropriately, and customer satisfaction is optimized

· Support is provided to the customer remotely by phone, internet and by onsite visits, as determined by the machine status or customer requirements Maintain complete and timely documentation of work activities

· Initial review of customer issues, such that customer concerns with product performance and safety are quickly communicated to Accuray for appropriate review and handling

· Assist in the training of other Customer Support staff, and customer or site personnel with respect to maintenance and service activities, as required

· Work with other FSEs and/or Customer Support Staff on CyberKnife or TomoTherapy products as required

· Appropriate care of parts inventory and prompt return of replaced parts that are required to be returned to Accuray for processing

· Appropriate management and timely completion of expense reports incurred in the field for customer service or company required travel and/or training

· Assist in the review and development of service documentation

· Assist in identification and development of field support tools and test equipment

· Maintain company vehicle (if provided) in accordance with Accuray fleet vehicle policy, including safe operations, vehicle cleanliness and vehicle maintenance

· Willing to travel up to 25% outside of assigned service area, sometimes with little notice

 

PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

· Provides feedback for service-related product improvements

· Assist in the development, documentation, and testing of service tools and design updates to the product

· Support project team activities, with attendance at team meetings, representation of field service requirements

Qualifications:

a. Required:

· Minimum 5 years’ experience in field service, installation, and troubleshooting complex electronic equipment or bachelor’s degree in with less field experience considered

· Successful candidates will demonstrate an ability to be a self-starter and have the ability to work without close supervision, be able to successfully schedule, organize and conduct field service activities in assigned territory

· The demonstrated ability to communicate complex information to a wide range of audiences including executive level management

· Strong system level troubleshooting skills

· Strong computer skills with an understanding of basic networking

· Strong interpersonal and presentation skills

· Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and work in a physically active environment

b. Preferred or Desired:

· Previous experience in large medical device field service strongly preferred

· Former military experience a plus

· Bachelor’s degree in engineering

· Knowledge of medical linear accelerator or microwave RF systems and computer networks preferred

· Robotics and or electro-mechanical systems service experience preferred

Job Details

We are seeking a highly skilled Information Retrieval Engineer to lead the development and optimization of retrieval systems that power context-aware large language models (LLMs). This role focuses on building robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure AI agents and applications have access to the most relevant, timely, and high-quality information.

You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and knowledge management—enabling better reasoning, accuracy, and performance for enterprise-grade AI systems.

Key Responsibilities

RAG System Design:

Architect and deploy scalable retrieval pipelines using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant)

Implement semantic search infrastructure and hybrid retrieval systems (semantic + keyword)

Data Processing & Ingestion:

Build ingestion pipelines for both structured and unstructured data sources

Implement document chunking strategies, embedding generation (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace), and metadata tagging

Retrieval Optimization:

Fine-tune relevance scoring, reranking algorithms, and query understanding mechanisms

Develop techniques to improve precision/recall for specific business domains or user tasks

Knowledge Enhancement:

Create and maintain knowledge graphs to support context linking and disambiguation

Manage data freshness and version control to ensure consistency and reliability of retrieved content

Reasoning Support:

Design and iterate on context window strategies that improve LLM reasoning (e.g., adaptive injection, task-based retrieval)

Collaborate with prompt engineers and model developers to align retrieval outputs with downstream model behavior

Performance Monitoring:

Track key retrieval metrics such as accuracy, latency, and fallback rate

Implement caching, prefetching, and deduplication strategies to optimize system responsiveness

Qualifications

Required:

4+ years in data engineering, ML infrastructure, or information retrieval

Experience building and deploying RAG pipelines or semantic search systems

Strong Python skills and familiarity with retrieval libraries (e.g., Haystack, LangChain, Elasticsearch, Milvus)

Proficiency with embedding models, vector similarity search, and document indexing

Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Docker)

Preferred:

Knowledge of graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, TigerGraph) or knowledge graph design

Experience optimizing retrieval for LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral)

Background in IR/NLP, Search Engineering, or Cognitive Computing

Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

Success in This Role Looks Like:

High-recall, low-latency retrieval pipelines that enhance LLM outputs with accurate, relevant context

Modular, reusable RAG components that can be applied across use cases and domains

Continuous improvement of retrieval relevance and reasoning alignment through experimentation and monitoring

Strong collaboration with AI engineers, prompt engineers, and data owners to maintain data quality and user trust

About the Role

Adobe Customer Solutions is seeking a Senior Adoption Digital Strategist with expertise in transformation, operating model design, and enterprise change management to lead adoption and value realization for Adobe’s most complex, high-impact customer programs.

This role is designed for a senior adoption leader with AI gravitas and deep passion—someone who can confidently advise executives on how AI reshapes operating models, decision-making, governance, and workforce capabilities, not just how tools are deployed. The Senior Adoption Digital Strategist operates as a trusted advisor to C-suite and senior leadership, shaping adoption strategy across multi-year, multi-workstream transformations. Has robust experience using AI agents for internal impact.

What You’ll Do

Drive Enterprise Adoption Strategy

Own and shape end-to-end adoption strategies for large-scale, AI-enabled transformation programs

Apply advanced change management expertise (Prosci ADKAR) to complex organizational, cultural, and capability shifts driven by marketing tech stack

Translate AI strategy into clear adoption roadmaps spanning operating model, governance, roles, and behaviors

Advise on AI Operating Models

Lead future-state operating model design for organizations adopting AI at scale

Define decision rights, governance structures, accountability models, and cross-functional ways of working enabled

Guide leaders through the organizational trade-offs required to move from experimentation to enterprise AI adoption

Drive Complex Program Adoption

Drive adoption across adoption-workstreams, multi-geography, and multi-year programs

Anticipate and manage adoption risks across interdependent teams, platforms, and business units

Partner with program leadership to integrate operating models and change strategy into overall program governance

Executive Leadership

Serve as an advisor to executives across Marketing, Digital, IT, Data, Operations, and HR

Lead executive visioning sessions focused on AI strategy, adoption readiness, and organizational implications

Communicate complex AI and organizational concepts with clarity, confidence, and executive presence

Measure Value & Institutionalize Change

Define adoption and value metrics tied to AI usage, behavior change, and business outcomes

Establish feedback loops and governance mechanisms to sustain AI adoption over time

Ensure AI adoption is responsible, scalable, and embedded into day-to-day operations

Mentor and develop strategists

Help set standards for AI adoption, operating model design, and change management excellence

Contribute thought leadership that builds Adobe’s point of view on AI adoption

What You Bring
 

Required Qualifications

5-7+ years of experience in adoption, change management, operating model design, or digital transformation roles within consulting or enterprise environments

Active Prosci ADKAR certification (or equivalent enterprise change methodology)

Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale transformation programs

Deep expertise in operating model design and organizational change

Exceptional executive communication and storytelling skills, including executive-ready presentations

AI agent creation skills 

Strong strategic, analytical, and systems-thinking capabilities

Willingness to travel to client sites as needed

You will lead well-established Solutions Consulting teams across North America and EMEA. You will craft a unified standard of excellence for both Creative Cloud and Document Cloud solutions. Set strategic direction and operating standards for the Global Solutions Consulting organization.

Drive revenue impact by elevating discovery, solution mapping, proof of value rigor, and storytelling

Partner closely with regional Sales leaders and Sales Operations to influence pipeline, forecast accuracy, and deal strategy.

Build and mentor a strong management bench, creating a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, curiosity, and growth.

Lead cross-functional collaboration with Product, PMM, Customer Success, and Professional Services.

Work with leadership team to establish global standard methodologies, demo frameworks, reusable assets, and enablement programs.

Represent Solutions Consulting as an executive sponsor with key customers.

10+ years of Solutions Consulting, Pre-Sales, or related experience, with 3–5+ years leading multi-region teams.

Deep proficiency in consultative discovery, value storytelling, enterprise architecture, and executive communication.

Creative approach to solving tough problems, operational rigor, and experience partnering across Sales, Product, and Customer Success.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior ML Engineer to join the Firefly team within Adobe's Applied Science and Machine Learning (ASML) organization. Firefly is Adobe's family of creative generative AI models that power next-generation creative experiences across Adobe's products. In this role, you will work at the frontier of multimodal AI by starting from foundational models and adapting them for various real-world use cases and products. You will develop and build innovative generation pipelines, bring powerful research into production, and collaborate closely with research, product, and infrastructure teams to invent the future of AI-powered creativity.

What you'll Do

Foundational Model Development & Adaptation

Engage with large-scale pretrained models for multimodal generation (image, text, video, and beyond) and tailor them to support Adobe Firefly products and features.

Research, prototype, and integrate brand-new techniques from the latest literature into production-grade generation pipelines.

Construct and refine innovative end-to-end pipelines for multimodal generation, balancing quality, performance, and scalability.

Data Strategy & User Workflows

Work alongside data and research teams to review, modify, and recommend improvements to data strategies that support model training and fine-tuning.

Analyze and iterate on user-facing workflows, translating product requirements into model and pipeline build decisions.

Contribute to dataset curation, annotation strategy, and evaluation frameworks for generative models.

Technical Excellence & Collaboration

Participate in build reviews and code reviews, upholding high standards for code quality, architecture, and reproducibility.

Build and maintain robust technical documentation, design documents, and engineering standards.

Collaborate with partner teams across ASML and contribute actively to technical roadmaps and cross-functional planning.

Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge through pairing, code review, and internal technical talks.

What you need to succeed

Technical Depth

5+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering, with a strong focus on deep learning for computer vision or multimodal generation.

Practical experience handling extensive, intricate ML codebases and current ML frameworks like PyTorch or Tensorflow in live settings.

Demonstrated experience in constructing and refining ML pipelines on a large scale — covering model training and fine-tuning all the way through inference and deployment.

Solid understanding of generative model architectures (e.g., diffusion models, transformers, GANs, VAEs) and experience adapting or training them for applied use cases.

Strong Python proficiency and software engineering fundamentals, including system build, testing, and debugging.

Experience in distributed training or inference on GPU clusters; knowledge of frameworks like Slurm or similar is an advantage.

Domain & Collaboration

Extensive knowledge of multimodal generation workflows — especially image or video generation — and the capability to quickly adopt new methods from research.

Demonstrated experience collaborating cross-functionally with research scientists, product managers, and infrastructure engineers.

Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute meaningfully to roadmap discussions and architectural decisions.

Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to thrive in a fast paced research and product environment.

Experience contributing to technical documentation, development proposals, or engineering standards.

Nice to Have

Experience with controllable generation, LoRA / fine-tuning workflows, or RLHF-based alignment techniques.

Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps tooling.

Prior experience working in a creative AI or media technology domain.

Contributions to open-source ML projects or peer-reviewed publications.

Education

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is required.

Master's degree or PhD, or equivalent experience, preferred.

This role sits at the heart of Adobe’s growth strategy, with a clear mandate to scale partner-led pipeline, revenue, and customer impact across the Adobe Digital Experience Cloud. You will define and execute the joint strategy with a top-tier global partner, aligning Adobe’s technology, industry solutions, and go-to-market motions with the integrator’s consulting, delivery, and services capabilities across the German market, while ensuring regional consistency and leverage across Central Europe.

Operating in a complex, matrixed environment, you will engage with stakeholders ranging from alliance leaders and solution architects to senior executives and C-level decision-makers. Your success will be measured by your ability to translate strategic alignment into tangible business outcomes—accelerating partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals, driving customer adoption, and building a scalable, high-impact partnership model across the region.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will act as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor for a global systems integrator in Germany, while collaborating with other Partner Alliance Managers to support and extend the partnership across Central Europe. You will shape joint priorities, lead executive alignment, and ensure disciplined execution across sales, marketing, and delivery teams.

You will develop and own Joint Business Plans that define shared objectives, investment areas, and success metrics, covering pipeline creation, bookings, customer adoption, and services attach. Working closely with Adobe Sales and Customer Success teams, you will ensure partner opportunities are identified early, properly registered, and executed seamlessly through to customer success.

A key part of the role is driving go-to-market impact. You will collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Partner Solution Consulting teams to design joint industry plays, solution offerings, and demand-generation initiatives. This includes sponsoring and shaping executive events, campaigns, and thought leadership activities that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue growth in Germany, while aligning with broader Central Europe priorities.

As a senior leader within Adobe’s partner ecosystem, you will bring a strong point of view on digital experience transformation, advising partners and customers on market trends and how Adobe’s full Experience Cloud portfolio can address their most critical business challenges. You have spent several years working directly with Global System Integrators or major consulting firms, ideally with strong exposure to the German market and experience operating across multiple countries or regions.

You combine strong commercial acumen with executive presence, enabling you to influence senior leaders and drive alignment at the highest levels. You are experienced in building and scaling partner businesses, developing joint value propositions, and translating strategy into execution that delivers measurable outcomes across both local and regional contexts.

Success in this role requires excellent communication and presentation skills, a proactive and resilient mindset, and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments. A bachelor’s degree is required; a master’s degree or equivalent professional experience is preferred.

What if data collaboration between enterprises could be as seamless, intelligent, and real-time as consumer apps — but built with enterprise-grade scale, privacy, and performance?

Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform (Real-Time CDP), part of Adobe Digital Experience, helps organizations unify known and anonymous data into real-time customer profiles. But profiles alone are not enough.

RTCDP Collaboration takes this further.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in the UI team, you will not just implement features — you will shape how enterprise data collaboration happens inside the Adobe ecosystem. You will help design the systems that allow businesses to connect, activate shared insights, and ultimately deliver more meaningful customer experiences.
If you are driven by complexity, ownership, and architectural impact — this is your challenge.

Create the future Adobe products by building and maintaining complex and robust user interfaces for our customers

Own the outcome by taking the initiative and ownership for the application design efforts while always optimizing for quality, scalability and performance.

Raise the bar by focusing on continuously innovating and seeking novel methods for addressing complex technical distributed system challenges.

Be genuine, serve as a mentor, foster a collaborative environment and encourage and guide team members by being honest and direct.

Work with and across teams and domains to collaborate.

Act with clarity and precision, ensuring projects are driven with a strong sense of ownership and direction.

What you will need to succeed:

Strong Frontend Engineering Foundation

7–10+ years building complex, data-driven web applications

Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript

Solid experience with React ecosystem (hooks, state management, performance optimization)

Experience with GraphQL and/or REST APIs

Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, accessibility

Experience building scalable component architectures and performant UIs

Testing & Engineering Quality

Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar E2E frameworks

Experience with Jest / React Testing Library or similar tools

Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines

Familiarity with frontend test strategies across unit, integration, and E2E layers

The Opportunity

Adobe is transforming the enterprise content supply chain with intelligent brand solutions that redefine how large organizations create, govern, and scale content. At the core of this transformation is Brand Brain, a first-of-its-kind AI system that captures an enterprise’s business context and brand identity, enabling teams to create and validate content that is consistently on-brand across tools, workflows, and channels.

We are looking for a Senior Developer to build of Brand Brain’s core services and infrastructure. This role is ideal for a senior full stack engineer who can design and build these key AI-powered content workflows that will help organizations create on-brand assets at scale. You will work across backend, AI orchestration layers, creative tooling, agentic workflows etc. This role sits at the intersection of creativity, engineering craftsmanship, and applied AI.

Impact You’ll Make

You will have an opportunity to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and can take a feature from concept to production. You will help architect build technology that helps enterprises create on-brand content at scale by building robust backend services, APIs and platforms that integrate Brand Brain into Adobe ecosystem and third-party enterprise apps.

The Opportunity

Adobe leads in creating world-class software solutions, and we are excited to welcome a new Software Development Engineer 5 to our vibrant team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. This is an outstanding chance to join a cooperative and driven environment where your work directly influences the success of innovative projects.

Responsibilities

Architect and deliver foundational systems that enable enterprises to build on-brand content at a global scale.

Develop strong backend services, APIs, and integration layers that embed Brand Brain deeply within the Adobe ecosystem and third-party enterprise platforms.

Drive engineering excellence across performance, reliability, observability, and secure-by-default building.

Contribute to crafting long-term platform architecture in a fast-paced, highly visible product area.

What You’ll Do

Define and evolve foundational architecture, including service boundaries, domain models, APIs, and internal platform capabilities supporting high-throughput, low-latency workloads.

Build and implement scalable microservices and AI orchestration layers powering intelligent content workflows and agentic systems.

Build strong APIs and connectors that connect Brand Brain with Adobe products and third-party enterprise software.

Ensure platform compliance with strict SLAs for availability, scalability, latency, and data governance.

Establish guidelines for observability, incident management, prioritization, and cost efficiency.

Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI-powered features to validate new product experiences.

Improve engineering quality through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, and technical mentorship.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of experience building high-quality backend systems and microservices with strong emphasis on scalability, resilience, and performance.

Deep proficiency in backend development using Python or Java (both preferred).

Strong experience designing, building, and operating RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs at scale.

Hands-on experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed systems.

Strong foundation in system build, modern architecture patterns, and engineering guidelines.

Demonstrated ability to take features from concept to production in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally across Product, Build, and AI/ML teams.

Nice to Have

Experience in AdTech, MarTech, Content Management Systems (CMS), or enterprise SaaS platforms.

Familiarity with large-scale data platforms, indexing, or search systems.

Experience integrating platforms across complex product ecosystems.

Exposure to Adobe or third-party creative ecosystems (e.g., Photoshop, Express, InDesign, Figma).

Experience shipping AI-powered features or working with agentic workflows.

Adobe Firefly’s ASML group invites research scientists and engineers passionate about conditional generation and editing of large generative AI models. This role emphasizes images and videos. We strive to advance generative AI technology while guaranteeing models possess excellent quality and control.

We are especially looking for candidates experienced in large-scale, industry-level pre-training and mid-training of multi-modality generative models. This role has a direct effect on the quality of Adobe’s image and video generation models, supporting next-generation creative workflows for millions of users.

As an Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a world-class team of applied researchers and engineers building the future of digital experiences. You will have the opportunity to innovate across the full training stack, collaborate across data, modeling, and product, and see your work ship to customers worldwide.

Job Responsibilities

Conduct innovative research and development in training large-scale generative AI models for image and video synthesis.

Develop, carry out, and carefully assess sophisticated techniques for conditional generation and editing. Emphasize improving instruction compliance, controllability, and visual clarity in pre-trained image and video models.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, engineers, and product teams to translate multimodal innovations into scalable downstream applications coordinated within Adobe products.

Develop and maintain robust evaluation pipelines to assess generative models across quality, efficiency, robustness, and safety metrics.

Translate research concepts and published work into production-ready implementations using Python and modern machine learning frameworks.

What you'll need to succeed

Possession of a Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.

Extensive practical experience in large-scale generative AI training concentrating on image and video generation and editing.

Familiarity with diffusion models, transformers, or other brand new generative architectures.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

Strong coding and prototyping ability in Python, PyTorch, and ML infrastructure tools.

Working with product teams on technology transfers.

Strong history of publishing in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related areas.

The Opportunity

Adobe seeks a Senior or Principal Engineering Program Manager with strategic and execution skills to support Adobe Analytics Product and Engineering teams in meeting vital business targets. The role involves building and growing the next generation of Adobe Analytics products, especially emphasizing agentic capabilities in the Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) portfolio.

You will operate in a highly complex, fast-evolving, and often ambiguous environment. The ideal candidate thrives in this setting — bringing structure to ambiguity, improving cross-functional alignment, and developing positive relationships across the organization. This is not a “task master” role. Serving as a reliable, hands-on partner embedded within the program team, you will work closely with Engineering, Product, UX, and Marketing leaders to drive outcomes.

You will be instrumental in advancing collaboration, communication, consistency in execution, and alignment within the CXO ecosystem — establishing yourself as a trusted and indispensable contributor. Experience leading software development programs and collaborating across Engineering, Product, and Marketing is essential.

If you feel driven to develop the future of Adobe’s analytical solutions in the emerging Agentic space, we’d love to meet you.

What you'll do:

Drive complex programs from concept through release.

Proactively identify risks, remove obstacles, and solve problems directly — taking ownership rather than waiting for direction.

Ensure strong operational hygiene across tools (JIRA, dashboards, status reporting).

Coordinate cross-functional dependencies across global teams, partnering closely with other Program Managers and collaborators.

Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs.

Mentor peers, effect positive change, and lead by example.

What you need to succeed:

Deep sense of ownership and accountability — you operate like a business owner.

Technical curiosity — you seek to understand how systems work and leverage AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, Codex) to accelerate insights and solutions.

Strong prioritization skills and the ability to complete tasks in a fast-paced, technically complex environment.

Strong interpersonal and communication abilities, capable of influencing various cross-functional groups and senior leadership.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, high attention to detail, and a focus on continuous improvement.

Proficiency in JIRA (basic), Confluence (basic), Excel (intermediate to advanced), and modern AI tooling.

10+ years of relevant experience, including engineering management and/or program management experience.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree preferred.

PMP, CSM, or Agile certifications preferred.

Adobe Firefly’s Applied Science & Machine Learning (ASML) group is seeking research scientists and engineers passionate about conditional generation and editing of large-scale generative AI models. They will concentrate on images and videos. Our aim is to advance generative AI and ensure models have high quality and controllability.

We are especially seeking candidates experienced in large-scale, industry-grade pre-training and mid-training of multi-modality generative models. This role directly influences the quality of Adobe’s image and video generation models, supporting next-generation creative workflows for millions of users.

As an Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a world-class team of applied researchers and engineers building the future of digital experiences. You will have the opportunity to innovate across the full training stack, collaborate across data, modeling, and product, and see your work ship to customers worldwide.

Job Responsibilities

Conduct innovative research and development in training large-scale generative AI models for image and video synthesis.

Develop, carry out, and carefully evaluate sophisticated techniques for conditional generation and editing. This work emphasizes improving instruction adherence, controllability, and the visual quality of pre-trained image and video models.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, engineers, and product teams to translate multimodal innovations into scalable downstream applications coordinated within Adobe products.

Define and build comprehensive evaluation frameworks and benchmarking pipelines to assess generative models across quality, efficiency, safety, and reliability, establishing guidelines and standards for the organization.

Translate research concepts and published work into production-ready implementations using Python and modern machine learning frameworks.

Collaborate with technical leads to build long-term technical strategy and roadmap, while mentoring and guiding junior engineers and researchers to elevate team capability and impact.

What you'll need to succeed

Hold a Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related area.

Extensive practical experience in large-scale generative AI training emphasizing the creation and modification of images and videos.

Familiarity with diffusion models, transformers, or other brand new generative architectures.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

Strong coding and prototyping ability in Python, PyTorch, and ML infrastructure tools.

Working with product teams on technology transfers

Strong history of publications in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related areas

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Senior Enterprise Architect Professional Services to join our team based in London.

As a Senior Enterprise Architect Professional Services, you will guide architecture through the transformation lifecycle. You will build executive confidence, govern design decisions, lead architecture build, and make sure technology choices support long-term value.

What you’ll do

You will bridge business goals and technical delivery by designing target architectures, planning transitions, and creating decommissioning strategies. Using change management frameworks such as ADKAR, you'll support adoption and sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

Assess and advance the architectural intent crafted during pre-sales.

Provide architectural leadership across the full transformation lifecycle and guide platform adoption and evolution.

Convert the success roadmap created during pre-sales into a comprehensive, managed transition plan featuring clear sequencing, decision points, and risk controls.

Formulate robust, industry-specific architectural perspectives and translate them into target-state architecture, reference models, and phased implementation plans.

Foster and maintain executive trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators.

Collaborate with licensing and services sales teams to improve major sales initiatives.

Coordinate architectural efforts among delivery teams, subject matter experts, and partners to ensure build integrity and alignment during execution.

Establish and lead architecture governance and assurance forums.

Partner closely with pre‑sales teams to ensure lessons learned, build patterns, and reference architectures continually improve future pursuits and delivery outcomes.

What you’ll need to succeed

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across large-scale transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Strong grounding in TOGAF principles and lifecycle-based architecture governance, applied pragmatically in complex enterprise environments.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor to senior executives.

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity.

Ability to apply structured change and adoption approaches (including ADKAR) to support the human and organisational aspects of architectural evolution.

A collaborative, outcome-focused leadership style, with a relentless focus on value and adoption.

Fluency in English is required. Any other european language would be a plus.

Firefly Enterprise is bringing generative AI into real creative workflows—directly inside the tools customers already use. JOB DESCRIPTION:

Informatics Technical Service Specialist 

Abbott Diagnostics (ADD) — Field Based (Scotland + UK Travel) 

Abbott is a global healthcare leader dedicated to helping people live fuller, healthier lives. Our innovations span diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and branded generic medicines — improving care for millions of people around the world. With 114,000 colleagues serving customers in 160+ countries, we’re committed to advancing the future of healthcare. 

About Abbott Diagnostics (ADD) 

As a global leader in in vitro diagnostics, Abbott provides cutting-edge instruments, software solutions, and tests that support hospitals, labs, and clinics worldwide. We help transform medical testing through automation, innovation, and a focus on delivering high-quality, cost-effective results that improve patient care. 

Our Informatics Team sits within the UKI Service Organisation — designed to meet the evolving needs of today’s large, complex healthcare customers. The team provides specialist informatics expertise, supporting both sales and service teams across the region. 

 

About the Role 

We’re looking for an Informatics Technical Service Specialist to Implement & support Complexed IT Infrastructure Solutions including implementation, optimization, and ongoing success of Abbott’s laboratory software solutions. 

This field-based role covers Scotland, with additional travel across UKI. 

You’ll play a key role in shaping exceptional customer experiences — combining IT expertise, problem-solving, hands-on support, and deep product knowledge to help laboratories get the best out of our informatics solutions. 

 

What You’ll Be Doing 

Collaborate with regional and local sales teams to support and grow existing customer accounts 

Build strong, trusted relationships with customers and use these to expand Abbott’s presence and value 

Lead IT implementation activities in line with the agreed Statement of Work 

Support the development and preparation of Statements of Work by gathering and validating technical needs 

Recommend appropriate hardware solutions for Abbott IT systems and coordinate with external hardware providers where required 

Carry out software installation, configuration, and setup activities 

Deliver clear, structured training to end users on Abbott software applications 

Provide comprehensive postimplementation support, resolving issues and optimising system performance 

Act as a technical expert across the full IT solution — supporting procurement, integration, and troubleshooting 

Continuously enhance the customer experience by optimising service quality and the performance of Abbott IT solutions 

​

Success is measured by: 

Customer satisfaction (NPS), service quality, operational effectiveness, and the growth of existing accounts. 

 

What You’ll Bring 

A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; science or medical related fields are a plus 

Strong technical understanding of IT systems and software within a healthcare or laboratory environment 

Experience delivering customer facing technical support or post sales service 

Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence, train, and build rapport 

A serviced riven mindset with a commercial awareness of customer needs 

Strong organisation, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities 

Ability to work effectively in cross functional teams 

Comfort with regular travel (typically around 3 days per week) 

 

What We Offer 

As you’d expect from a global healthcare leader, we offer an excellent package including a competitive salary, defined contribution pension scheme, private healthcare, life assurance, and a flexible benefits programme tailored to you.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Thoratec Switzerland GmbH – Abbott Medical | Zürich

Thoratec Switzerland GmbH, part of Abbott Medical, develops and manufactures life‑saving mechanical circulatory support devices—CentriMag and HeartMate 3—supporting patients with advanced heart failure around the world.

We are expanding our team in Zürich and are looking for a:

Manager NPI Engineering

A leadership role at the intersection of innovation, manufacturing excellence, and patient impact.

Why This Role Matters

This is a highly crossfunctional position where your leadership will directly influence how breakthrough technologies move from design into safe, reliable, real world manufacturing. You will guide a diverse team of engineers, shape future products, collaborate across multiple sites, and play a vital role in delivering therapies that truly change lives.

We welcome applicants who bring curiosity, empathy, and strong collaboration skills alongside their technical expertise. If you enjoy leading people, building processes, and working in an environment where every voice is valued, this could be the perfect next step.

What You’ll Be Doing

Key responsibilities and activities

Build up and lead the NPI team comprising of up to 8 engineers (software, electronics, mechanics).

Together with the relevant cross-functional stakeholders:

Define work packages for the design transfer to manufacturing in compliance with internal and external procedures and regulations

Estimate time and cost of the design transfer work packages

Coordinate and synchronize your activities closely with the cross-site program management, R&D, supply chain, quality engineering, manufacturing engineering, production, OPEX and finance.

Ensure design for manufacturability, assembly and test according to best practices.

Prepare plans and execute them to set up and qualify new production lines.

Define and implement within the plants the necessary processes to guarantee the availability of components, resources, tools, equipment and the high quality of the products delivered.

Perform the risk analysis & reporting, risk review boards, define and implement mitigation actions.

Establish efficient lines of communication to ensure commitments and deadlines are met and issues are resolved.

Define and follow KPIs’ to measure the timeline, cost, and quality of the design transfer.

Your Profile

We encourage applications from individuals who may not meet every requirement—if you believe you can make an impact, we want to hear from you.

Must‑Have Qualifications

Master’s degree in science or engineering

Minimum 5 years’ experience in NPI, industrialization, or product creation

Minimum 5 years in MedTech or pharma; strong knowledge of ISO13485/FDA21CFR820/MDR/GMP

Minimum 3 years of people leadership

Strong project management experience (cross‑functional and multi‑site)

Excellent communication skills

Fluent English (negotiation level)

Nice‑to‑Have

Further education in business, project management, or leadership

Fluent German

Experience in fast‑paced, regulated environments

A structured, analytical mindset with a collaborative working style

Openness to diverse cultures and ways of working

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott 

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of .

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity 

This position works out of our Imazium Damansara Uptown location in the Core Diagnostic. We’re empowering smarter medical and economic decision making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, more than 10 million tests are run on Abbott’s diagnostics instruments, providing lab results for millions of people.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments and informatics systems are often the first step in patient care decision making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers.

The Area Service Professional primary job function is responsible for level 3 operations for laboratory instruments and automation hardware. This role involves troubleshooting, customer engagement, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure high-quality service delivery and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Do 

Take ownership of Level 3 support for Abbott instruments and automation hardware-related products, ensuring timely resolution in alignment with Global Service Guidance.

Assist in on-site investigations and basic troubleshooting and contribute to the planning and execution of technical studies

Conduct thorough customer entrance interviews to assess needs and manage expectations within defined service parameters.

Identify critical process gaps and recommend improvements to enhance cross-functional workflows and service delivery.

Ensure adherence to regulatory and quality standards during service activities and promote best practices in ticket documentation.

Thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed, and geographically diverse organization, demonstrating adaptability and initiative.

Set clear goals and provide constructive feedback to foster collaboration and drive business outcomes.

Deliver clear, concise and fact-based verbal and written communications to executive leadership, peers and cross-functional teams.

Champion quality, lean methodologies and structured problem-solving across the service organization and in collaboration with other departments.

Establish well defined cadence with APAC Service Managers to drive Cost of Service (COS) reduction utilizing tools and analytic.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering / electrical / mechanical or medical technology or Biochemistry is preferred

Experience in technical service in the IVD industry

Strong understanding of instrument hardware and/or engineering principles, with a strong interest in expanding expertise in laboratory instruments and systems.

Proficient in Microsoft technologies, including Windows virtualization, MS Visio, and other Microsoft Office applications.

Fundamental knowledge in Power BI is considered an advantage.

Familiarity with industry-standard communication protocols such as ASTM, HL7 and other proprietary protocols

Strong analytical thinking and a curious mindset

Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills. Able to work effectively in cross-functional and collaborative team environments.

Ability to develop, advocate for, and implement new ideas and approaches that drive continuous improvement.

Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

About the Role

The Regional Security Manager plays a key role in supporting Abbott’s commitment to safeguarding our people, products, and operations across a diverse and evolving risk environment. This position leads regional security operations, advances Abbott’s Global Security (GS) strategy, and ensures consistent protection standards across manufacturing sites, commercial offices, supply‑chain nodes, and field operations. The role requires strong leadership, deep expertise in corporate security within a global organization, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional teams supporting Abbott’s healthcare mission.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and oversee day‑to‑day regional security operations, ensuring alignment with Abbott Global Security (GS) policies, programs, and enterprise risk priorities.

Develop and execute regional security goals, protocols, and operational plans that support Abbott’s strategic objectives and enable business continuity across manufacturing, logistics, commercial, and R&D environments.

Review, refine, and implement security procedures designed to protect employees, facilities, high‑value products, supply‑chain activity, and sensitive operational assets.

Conduct ongoing assessments of threats, vulnerabilities, and operational risks impacting Abbott sites, field teams, and distribution channels; implement mitigation measures based on findings.

Monitor regional disruptions, including crime trends, civil unrest, natural hazards, and geopolitical developments, and coordinate response strategies with local business leaders and global security partners.

Serve as the regional lead for major security events, coordinating closely with Abbott leadership, cross‑functional teams, external security partners, and local law enforcement as required.

Oversee and conduct investigations related to threats, security incidents, potential product diversion, and workplace violence matters, ensuring timely and actionable reporting.

Design and deliver security training programs to strengthen preparedness, employee awareness, and adherence to Abbott security standards.

Produce after‑action reports following security events and coordinate implementation of follow‑up actions or corrective measures.

Communicate security matters clearly and effectively to senior leaders, providing insights that support informed decision‑making across corporate, manufacturing, and supply‑chain functions.

Evaluate, select, and manage security vendors and contracted guarding services to ensure high‑quality, compliant, and cost‑effective performance.

Strengthen internal processes, governance, and audit readiness across regional operations to reduce risk and support Abbott’s compliance and quality commitments.

Lead special security projects in support of Abbott Global Security initiatives or business‑driven requirements.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience; advanced degree preferred.

15+ years of experience in security, risk management, or operations within a corporate or global organization.

Demonstrated experience as a Security Manager with strong leadership capability in complex, high‑risk, or multinational environments.

Expertise in operational security, physical security, travel security, crisis management, and workplace violence prevention within a corporate or manufacturing context.

Proven experience developing and implementing security plans, crisis‑management frameworks, investigative processes, and incident‑response protocols.

Strong background in incident reporting, threat assessments, and risk analytics.

Ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate effectively across global, cross‑functional teams including Supply Chain, HR, Manufacturing, Quality, Legal, and Communications.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with strong presentation and reporting capabilities.

High‑level judgment and decision‑making skills, with the ability to lead during high‑pressure situations.

Experience selecting, managing, and evaluating external security partners, including guarding and investigative vendors.

Willingness to travel within the region and internationally as required.

Bilingual (English and Spanish) required, with the ability to operate confidently across multicultural environments.

The Opportunity

At P50, you’ll be a technical leader shaping the plugin platform and engineering practices for extensibility at scale. You’ll drive architecture, guide major initiatives, and partner with PM/Design/Platform teams to deliver flexible, enterprise-ready plugin experiences. The problem we’re solving large creative organizations need a way to generate and iterate on brand-safe content inside existing creative workflows (where templates and day-to-day production happen). Without a plugin approach, teams are forced into tool switching, duplicated work, template rewrites, and brittle integrations that don’t scale across hosts or channels. We’re building an extensible plugin foundation that enables in-tool creation, consistent field-role mapping, robust API-driven generation/editing flows, and smooth handoff to GenStudio for downstream governance. This is still frontend-first, but you’ll be expected to operate confidently across boundaries—API design, service integration, and pragmatic full-stack problem solving.
 

What you’ll do

Lead the architecture of GeoStudio plugin experiences and shared frontend infrastructure (patterns, abstractions, extensibility strategy).

Drive complex, high-impact initiatives end-to-end: from ambiguous problem definition to delivery, rollout strategy, and iteration based on feedback.

Set engineering direction on quality, performance, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability for plugin UI and integration layers.

Define and influence API contracts with backend/platform teams to ensure developer-friendly, scalable integrations.

Establish durable patterns for async workflows (job polling, progress UX, cancellation, retries, partial failures, and user trust).

Mentor and raise the bar: guide senior and junior engineers, run technical reviews, and create a culture of strong ownership and crisp execution.

Collaborate cross-functionally at a high level: align with PM/Design on roadmap, scope trade-offs, and extensible product design.

What you need to succeed

8–12+ years of industry experience with deep frontend expertise and strong architectural ownership.

Expert knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend architecture (component systems, state, performance, testing, build tooling).

Demonstrated success designing and shipping reusable, extensible frontend systems used across teams/products.

Strong experience integrating with REST/GraphQL APIs, handling auth and async workflows, and designing resilient client systems.

Ability to provide technical leadership, navigate ambiguity, and communicate clearly with engineering and product leadership.

Nice to have

Experience building products involving GenAI/LLMs (prompting patterns, model capabilities/limits, evaluation thinking, safety/guardrails).

Experience with enterprise requirements: entitlements, custom models, metering/usage considerations, compliance, and governance handoffs.

Practical full-stack skills (Node.js/microservices) and comfort owning small backend components when it unblocks the team.

Experience building developer-facing SDKs, shared libraries, or platform surfaces.

We’re the market leader in software products and services that power the world’s creative, document, and marketing ecosystems — from Creative Cloud and Document Cloud to Firefly, Express, and Experience Cloud. We are looking for an incredible individual to drive thought leadership, innovation, and commercial partnerships that inspire and accelerate enterprise adoption of GenAI in creativity, film and enterprises.

This person will be equal parts technologist, storyteller, and dealmaker — passionate about shaping the future of creativity, and skilled at translating innovation into business impact.

A successful candidate will have the technical AI chops to be respected by our eng and researchers, strong c-level relationship building skills, an ability to rally internal cross-functional partners and a founder mentality.

What You’ll Do

Ignite new business and partnerships: Lead Firefly Foundry engagements from concept to commercial deal, collaborating with Adobe’s enterprise sales and creative leadership teams.

Bridge creative vision with technology: Translate the needs of filmmakers, studios, creators, and brands into Foundry use cases that showcase “the art of the possible.”

Shape Adobe’s role in the entertainment and creator ecosystem: Build trusted relationships across studios, media companies, YouTube creators, agencies, and enterprise partners.

Advise and evangelize: Serve as a GenAI authority and creative industry leader with vision — presenting at customer meetings, partner events, and major conferences.

Collaborate across the enterprise: Work closely with Adobe Research, Firefly engineering, marketing, and product teams to test, validate, and influence future product directions.

Be hands-on: Prototype creative solutions, demo Firefly APIs and integrations, and bring ideas to life with tangible visual and storytelling proof points.

What you'll need to succeed

10+ years of experience across creative technology, media, entertainment, or enterprise partnerships.

A strong mix of technical fluency (AI, creative tools, APIs, cloud platforms) and creative depth (film, video, digital storytelling, YouTube, or content production).

Proven success launching or scaling products or experiences — ideally in a startup, 0→1, or innovation lab environment.

A network in the entertainment and creator ecosystem — and the confidence to navigate C-suite, studio, and creator conversations.

Entrepreneurial outlook: a “player-coach” who rolls up their sleeves and thrives in ambiguity.

High EQ, low ego, and a natural ability to connect teams, ideas, and opportunities.

Comfort operating as both strategist and creative technologist, who can drive both impact and storytelling.

Great teammate (roll up your sleeves, adaptable work style, lead via influence, excellent “connector”)

Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualizations for executive audiences (Power BI, Tableau, Adobe Workspace).

Strong expertise in Python, SQL, Spark, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Good communication skills: ability to tell the data story, influence decisions, and partner effectively with senior leaders.

Adobe purchases products and services from thousands of suppliers each year. We aim to accelerate Adobe's continued commercial success through outstanding strategic sourcing. Lead end-to-end commercial strategy for global cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including complex enterprise agreements, consumption optimization, and long-term capacity planning.

Proactively seek value-creating opportunities across spend categories

Deep market knowledge software contracting trends, licensing models, and business models.

Excellent emotional intelligence (EQ) & influence with various partners, and improving business dynamics both within Global Procurement and broadly across Adobe; evidence of continuous positive customer feedback.

Adobe empowers individuals and organizations to create exceptional content effortlessly. The AI for Engineering team builds a scalable, production-grade AI platform that powers creativity across design, imaging, motion, and personalization.

We are seeking a Staff Engineer - AI for Engineering to design and build the next-generation AI systems that bring intelligent, adaptive, and agentic experiences to Adobe Express.

This role is ideal for an engineer who deeply understands how modern LLMs and generative models behave in real-world systems — including reasoning patterns, tool use, prompt dynamics, failure modes, and orchestration strategies — and can translate that understanding into scalable, production-ready platforms.

You will define and build the end-to-end architecture that enables Agentic AI solutions solving real engineering problems— spanning model orchestration, tool integration, memory systems, inference services, data flows, evaluation loops, and real-time decision systems.

This is a systems-first AI role focused on building intelligent platforms.

What You’ll Do

A core part of this role is building scalable Agentic AI platforms that empower developers, significantly boost engineering productivity, and accelerate AI adoption across the organization.

Architect and evolve the AI platform powering Adobe Engineering — with a strong emphasis on Agentic AI systems and LLM-native architectures.

Design and implement scalable orchestration layers that coordinate LLMs, tools, APIs, memory stores, and multi-step reasoning workflows.

Build production-grade agent frameworks that support planning, task decomposition, tool invocation, multi-agent collaboration, and persistent memory.

Develop high-performance inference and runtime systems with strong guarantees around latency, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency.

Design evaluation and feedback systems that measure reasoning quality, task success, hallucination rates, and agent behavior — enabling rapid iteration and continuous improvement.

Integrate first-party and third-party foundation models into cohesive, adaptive systems using routing, model selection, guardrails, and fallback strategies.

Design data flows, session-level intelligence, and contextual memory systems that allow agents to operate coherently across interactions.

Partner with applied research, product, and platform teams to bring intelligent agentic capabilities into real developer-facing experiences.

Drive architectural strategy for AI for Engineering — connecting models, reasoning engines, tools, and data streams into adaptive AI systems.

Mentor senior engineers in modern AI system design, LLM orchestration patterns, and agent platform architecture.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, AI platforms, or intelligent service architectures.

Deep understanding of how LLMs behave in production environments — including prompting strategies, reasoning chains, tool usage, grounding techniques, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, and evaluation patterns.

Strong experience building AI-powered systems using LLM orchestration frameworks, model routing strategies, and multi-model pipelines.

Hands-on experience designing agentic systems — including reasoning loops, memory persistence, tool integration, state management, and multi-agent coordination.

Proven expertise in building scalable, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures with strong observability and reliability.

Experience designing evaluation systems for generative AI quality, task completion, and behavioral robustness.

Proficiency in TypeScript, Python and at least one systems language (Java, Go, C++), with experience building production AI services.

Strong systems thinking — ability to connect model capabilities, runtime constraints, and product requirements into coherent architectures.

Excellent multi-functional communication skills, with experience influencing architectural direction across research and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting AI assistants, copilots, or agent platforms in production environments.

Experience working with multimodal generative systems (text, image, video, motion).

Familiarity with tool-augmented LLM systems, RAG architectures, vector databases, and contextual memory systems.

Exposure to evaluation frameworks for generative AI quality and safety.

Experience contributing to open-source AI frameworks or publishing technical thought leadership.

Machine Learning Engineer

Focus: From Research to Product | Digital Video & Audio

Location: Noida / Bengaluru

The Opportunity

Adobe’s Digital Video & Audio group develops some of the most innovative and popular creative tools worldwide. These include Premiere, After Effects, and Audition, available on desktop, mobile, web, and cloud.

AI is fundamentally transforming how creators imagine, produce, and share content. We’re looking for a passionate Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about turning innovative research into intuitive, reliable product experiences used by millions of creators worldwide.

In this position, you will work closely with senior engineers, applied researchers, and diverse collaborators to turn experimental ML prototypes into scalable, production-ready systems. If you enjoy tackling complex machine learning problems in video, audio, and multimodal media — and feel driven by having your innovations incorporated into real products — this is an outstanding chance to create meaningful impact.

You will gain hands-on exposure to production-scale ML systems while directly crafting how AI powers Adobe’s creative ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Drive the development of ML-powered features from early-stage research prototypes to robust production deployments.

Compose, build, and optimize scalable ML pipelines for video understanding, multimodal intelligence, and generative AI applications.

Implement, experiment with, and fine-tune brand new deep learning models across Computer Vision, Video AI, and Generative AI domains.

Solve real-world creator challenges involving spatial, temporal, and multimodal data.

Lead model evaluation, benchmarking, validation, and performance optimization to ensure high quality and reliability.

Optimize and deploy models across heterogeneous environments (CPU/GPU/NPU), including ONNX and CoreML workflows.

Improve model efficiency through quantization, pruning, distillation, and inference acceleration techniques.

Write clean, modular, maintainable, and well-tested production-quality ML code.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, product managers, designers, and platform engineers to deliver impactful roadmap-aligned features.

Remain updated on emerging ML techniques and actively integrate innovations into video and media workflows.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

5+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or related domains.

Proven experience building, scaling, and deploying ML models in production environments with measurable impact.

Strong proficiency in PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow, and Python-based ML development.

Solid foundations in mathematical modeling, including Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, and optimization theory.

Deep understanding of core ML principles: model training, validation, generalization, and performance trade-offs.

Strong grasp of deep learning architectures including CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, and multimodal models. Clear understanding of when and why to apply each architecture for spatial, temporal, or cross-modal tasks.

Practical experience in computer vision tasks such as object detection, segmentation, tracking, video understanding, or temporal modeling.

Familiarity with model optimization and deployment techniques including pre/post training quantization, ONNX, CoreML, and edge deployment.

Understanding of software engineering guidelines including version control (Git), testing frameworks, CI/CD, and code review processes.

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and curiosity to learn in a fast-evolving AI landscape.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within diverse, high-performing teams.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Develop AI systems that support millions of creators around the world.

See your ideas move from research to real-world impact.

Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers.

Address significant, large-scale ML challenges in video and media.

Grow in an environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.

The opportunity 

We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to lead security initiatives that improve and secure Adobe’s cloud infrastructure and ensure our security posture. 

The role will provide the opportunity to work on a diverse set of projects and will also include development of prototypes and proof-of-concepts, engagement with product teams, and initiatives that span across multiple organizations. You’ll be working to build tooling and drive initiatives that solve complex and impactful security challenges across the cloud. 

 

What you'll Do 

Secure our cloud infrastructure and processes through building security tools and developing and driving risk reduction initiatives. 

Collaborate with teams across the organization to build complex tooling that interact with multiple systems, processes, and standards. 

Lead Adobe’s logging strategy across public and private cloud. 

Provide cloud expertise to design new processes and tooling to solve security risks. 

Help improve the availability, performance, scalability, and security of Adobe's security tools. 

Keep elevated levels of Security and Compliance with the Adobe Standards. 

Serve as a hands-on technical contributor to our evolving architecture. 

 

 

 

What you need to succeed 

Experience with cloud service providers, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS, or Google GCP. Extensive experience with Azure is preferred. 

Deep understanding and experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Azure Monitor/Log Analytics. 

Experience solving widespread security issues in the cloud through both building custom solutions and using cloud native services. 

Experience building infrastructure with CloudFormation and/or Terraform, as well as experience with scripting languages (e.g. Python, Ruby, Rust, Go). 

Knowledge of orchestration tools, (e.g. SaltStack, Ansible, Chef, Puppet) and CI/CD infrastructure (e.g. Jenkins). 

Knowledge of security infrastructure tools and components; network security; operating system fundamentals; etc. 

Experience writing user documentation. 

Strong understanding of common security concepts that support root-cause analysis to make data-driven decisions on patterns and trends. 

Prior experience working in an agile/agile-like development workflow. 

Experience implementing projects that require working with teams across an organization. This role will require collaboration with many partner teams. Being able to successfully execute projects that require this scale of collaboration is essential for success in this role. 

Ability to create detailed project plans and execute them end-to-end. 

Dependability: Meets commitments, works independently, accepts accountability, handles change, sets personal standards, stays focused under pressure 

Effective communication skills. 

Align with Adobe's values: Genuine, Exceptional, Innovative, and Involved.

The Opportunity

Join Adobe's Cyber Defense Center as a Senior Cyber Threat Researcher and play a pivotal role in our security operations. This outstanding opportunity allows you to drive the end-to-end intelligence lifecycle, transforming data into actionable insights that improve detection, accelerate incident response, and inform risk decisions. Your expertise will be crucial in researching emerging threats, investigating suspicious activities, and rapidly disseminating intelligence to the teams that need it most. Your sharp instincts and attention to detail will help protect sensitive data and ensure business continuity!

What you'll Do

Own the intelligence lifecycle from requirements to dissemination, delivering timely and actionable intelligence.

Map findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the Diamond Model to enable decision-quality outcomes.

Operate and mature the threat intelligence platform, manage STIX/TAXII feeds, and build automations.

Collaborate closely with the Threat Hunting team to proactively identify adversary behaviors.

Work with the Detection Engineering Team to operationalize intelligence into new or improved detections.

Apply SIEM tools and data lakes to shift across logs, EDR telemetry, and large datasets.

Collaborate with the Incident Response team during investigations to contextualize indicators and develop attribution hypotheses.

Produce high-quality intelligence deliverables and communicate complex findings clearly.

Participate in a bi-monthly on-call rotation to support a resilient defensive operations model.

What you need to succeed

5+ years in Cyber Threat Intelligence/Threat Research or equivalent experience in other security domains.

Proficiency with SIEM platforms, EDR solutions, and data analytics environments.

Skilled in scripting and automation with Python and comfortable with SQL-like query languages.

Familiarity with STIX/TAXII, YARA/Sigma, DNS/HTTP/network fundamentals, and related technologies.

Prior hands-on experience with threat management platforms/TIPs is preferred.

Experience with AI tools and the capability to incorporate AI into automation workflows.

Deep knowledge of emerging threats and threat actors; able to track campaigns and pivot across various sources.

Solid understanding of security and privacy fundamentals across cloud and on-prem environments.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to present information to executives and work alongside partner teams.

Strong case and knowledge-management habits; ability to manage multiple requests and meet tight deadlines.

Willingness to participate in on-call as needed.
